column1: # Ilocano pronunciation lexicon: word <TAB> IPA. Mined from the STRESS-MARKED referees (kaikki ilo +
# wikipron ilo_latn, both human), normalized to our conventions. Fixes what the rule g2p cannot derive
# from spelling: LEXICAL gliding (garcia→ɡaɾsia stays, kua→kua) + the 6th vowel ⟨e⟩→[ɯ] + lexical stress.
# The shipped phonemizeWord consults this first; phonemizeWordRules (the eval path) bypasses it → NON-CIRCULAR.
